description: Real estate lead generation in Gurgaon by micro-market: Meta and Google setup, HRERA-safe ads, NRI follow-up and how to cut your cost per site visit.
headline: Real estate lead generation in Gurgaon: a micro-market playbook for site visits
card_title: Real estate lead generation in Gurgaon
card_text: Plan campaigns by micro-market, keep ads HRERA-safe, handle NRI buyers and judge every rupee by cost per site visit.
intro:
Real estate lead generation in Gurgaon is harder than in most Indian cities. Dozens of projects launch on the same corridors, buyers enquire on several of them in one evening, and portals sell the same lead to several brokers. If your campaign treats "Gurugram" as one market, you pay for clicks from people who were never going to visit your site.

This guide is for developers, channel partners and brokers who want more site visits, not just more leads. It covers how to plan by micro-market, what to run on Meta and Google, how to stay within Haryana RERA rules, how to handle NRI enquiries, and the numbers to watch each week. For the general basics that apply across the region, see our Delhi NCR real estate lead generation guide.

sections.h2: Plan by micro-market, not by city
sections.html:
A buyer looking at Dwarka Expressway is not the same person as one shortlisting Golf Course Extension Road or Sohna. Each corridor attracts a different budget, a different reason to buy and a different set of competing projects. Build a separate campaign, landing page and set of creatives for each micro-market you sell in.

Micro-marketWho usually enquiresWhat to lead with
Dwarka ExpresswayUpgraders from West Delhi and Dwarka, airport and Delhi commutersConnectivity to Delhi and the airport, possession timeline, family amenities
Golf Course Road and Golf Course Extension RoadSenior professionals, business owners, NRIs looking at premium homesDeveloper track record, specifications, walkthrough video, privacy and space
Southern Peripheral Road and New GurugramYoung families and first-time buyers working in GurugramCommute to offices, schools nearby, payment plan clarity
Sohna and the southern sectorsBudget buyers and investorsEntry price range, approvals, plotted and affordable options

Treat this table as a starting hypothesis. Your own lead data will tell you within a few weeks which areas of Delhi NCR your real buyers come from, and that should reshape your targeting.

Projects in Gurugram are registered with the Haryana Real Estate Regulatory Authority (HRERA), Gurugram. Under the RERA Act, a project must be registered before it is advertised or sold, and ads for registered projects should show the registration number and the RERA website where buyers can check it. HRERA Gurugram has fined developers for ads that left these out or promised amenities that were not in the approved plan, so this is not a formality.

  • No pre-registration "EOI" campaigns. Collecting expressions of interest with money for a project that is not yet registered runs against the Act. Wait for the registration.
  • Registration number on everything. Static ads, video end cards, landing pages, brochures and the WhatsApp auto-reply.
  • Claims that match the approved plan. Amenities, possession dates and scheme names (for example, affordable or plotted colony schemes) should match what was filed.
  • Prices with conditions. If you show a starting price, state what it includes.

Rules and their interpretation change, so check the current HRERA Gurugram guidance with your legal team before you launch. On Meta, also check whether your account is asked to declare a special ad category for housing, as that limits targeting options.

sections.h2: What to run on Meta in Gurugram
sections.html:
Meta (Facebook and Instagram) is usually where most project leads come from, because it reaches people before they start searching. The trick is to make the ad and the form filter for you.

  1. Lead forms with higher intent. Ask budget, configuration (2, 3 or 4 BHK, floor or plot), buying timeline and own use or investment. Fewer people finish the form, but your sales team calls fewer dead numbers.
  2. Video before static. A 30 to 45-second site or sample-flat walkthrough with the corridor named in the first three seconds tells buyers far more than a render, and gives you a warm audience to remarket to.
  3. Location targeting from your own data. Start with Gurugram plus the parts of Delhi that feed your corridor, then adjust as booked site visits show where buyers really live.
  4. Remarketing to video viewers. People who watched most of the walkthrough are your warmest audience for a site visit offer.

Our Facebook and Instagram ads team rotates new creatives every week, because the same render shown for a month across a busy corridor goes stale quickly.

Google Search catches buyers who already know what they want. Keep it tight:

  • Project and developer name searches, including common misspellings, so portals and brokers don't capture your own brand traffic.
  • Locality and configuration searches such as "3 BHK on Dwarka Expressway", "ready to move flats in Sector 65 Gurgaon" or "builder floor in South City".
  • Negative keywords for rent, PG, jobs, resale and "near me" searches that bring tenants instead of buyers.
  • Call extensions and call tracking, because many Gurugram buyers prefer to call straight from the ad.

Add YouTube walkthroughs for reach and Performance Max only once your conversion tracking can tell a genuine site visit from a form fill. A Google Ads agency should set that tracking up in week one.

Gurugram's premium corridors draw interest from NRIs and from buyers working abroad. They enquire at hours your local team is asleep, so a slow reply loses them.

  • Separate campaigns for the countries you want, with creatives that answer NRI questions: who manages the visit, how payments work and how often they get construction updates.
  • Instant WhatsApp replies with the brochure, location map and RERA details, followed by a call booked in their time zone.
  • Video site visits offered as the first step, with a family member in Delhi NCR invited for the physical visit.

Our WhatsApp marketing guide covers auto-replies and follow-up flows in detail.

sections.h2: Follow up fast and protect lead data
sections.html:
In a market where buyers compare several projects at once, speed decides who gets the site visit. Set these targets with your sales team:

  1. WhatsApp auto-reply within a minute of the enquiry.
  2. A human call within 15 minutes during working hours.
  3. Two specific site visit slots offered on the first call, such as Saturday 11 am or Sunday 4 pm.
  4. A reminder the evening before and a cab or location pin on the morning of the visit.

Put every lead into one CRM or shared sheet with the source campaign attached, so you can see which ad produced which booking. Ask for clear consent on forms before you message people. India's Digital Personal Data Protection Rules were notified in November 2025 with obligations phasing in over the following months, so check what applies to you now.

sections.h2: Judge campaigns by cost per site visit
sections.html:
Cost per lead is the easiest number to report and the easiest to fool yourself with. A cheap lead that never visits is worth nothing. Track these four numbers every week, by micro-market and by campaign:

NumberHow to work it outWhy it matters
Cost per leadAd spend ÷ leadsEarly signal of creative and targeting
Contact rateLeads reached on call ÷ leadsShows fake numbers and slow follow-up
Cost per site visitAd spend ÷ completed site visitsThe number that predicts sales
Cost per bookingAd spend ÷ bookingsTells you whether to scale

When cost per lead rises but cost per site visit falls, the campaign is improving. Cut budgets based on site visits, never on leads alone.

1. Week 1: one landing page per project with the HRERA number, map, floor plans, walkthrough video and a site visit button. Install call, form and WhatsApp tracking.
  2. Week 2: launch Meta lead forms with qualifying questions for each micro-market, plus Google Search on project and locality keywords.
  3. Week 3: add remarketing to video viewers and site visitors, and an NRI campaign if the project suits it.
  4. Week 4: review cost per site visit by campaign, pause the bottom third and put the budget into what produced visits.

We run this as a 90-day sprint for property businesses across Delhi NCR from our Dwarka office. See how we work as a digital marketing agency in Delhi NCR, or compare channels in our Google Ads vs Facebook ads guide.

faqs: How do builders in Gurgaon get real estate leads?

Most combine Meta lead ads with qualifying questions, Google Search on project and locality keywords, portal listings and channel partners. The ones that get more site visits plan campaigns by micro-market, reply on WhatsApp within minutes and judge spend by cost per site visit.
Can I advertise a Gurugram project before HRERA registration?

No. Under the RERA Act a project must be registered before it is advertised, marketed or sold. Once registered, show the registration number and the RERA website on your ads and landing pages, and check current HRERA Gurugram guidance before launch.
Is Facebook or Google better for real estate leads in Gurgaon?

Meta usually brings more leads at a lower cost because it reaches people before they search. Google Search brings fewer but more ready buyers looking for a specific project or locality. Most Gurugram launches use both and compare them by cost per site visit.
How can I reach NRI property buyers for a Gurugram project?

Run separate campaigns for the countries you want, answer NRI questions about payments, visits and updates in the creative, reply instantly on WhatsApp and offer a video site visit before a physical one with family in Delhi NCR.
